description: Phase 11 (ADR 0017) stage 3, enforcement: ENGINE_SIGNING_MODE=enforce on the diagnosis Lambda. The orchestrator-only fields (mode, understand, canonical, established, seed, feedback) are honoured only with a valid AC signature; without one they are dropped and the request is handled as plain {messages}. Gate met: 60 days of logs show engine requests using mode never exceed orchestrator invocations; in the log-only window (since 11.2b) every unsigned use is accounted for (the orchestrator before its signer, and operator probes), none from the S4R origin; every orchestrator call verifies. Environment only. Rollback: ENGINE_SIGNING_MODE=log (configuration only).
classification: POTENTIALLY IMPACTS S4R (diagnosis Lambda configuration; S4R sends only {messages}, which carries no internal field; /part-finder contract, ingress, smoke and S4R health checked before and after)
grantNotes: Environment update of the diagnosis Lambda and PassRole on its own unchanged role.
